question: _______ has become the first Indian track-and-field athlete to win medals at consecutive Olympics.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neeraj Chopra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** is the first Indian track-and-field athlete to win medals at consecutive Olympics.
 
• He won a **gold medal in the javelin throw event** at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**.
 
• Chopra secured a **silver medal** in the javelin throw at the **2024 Paris Olympics**.
 
• He is one of the most prominent and successful athletes in India's sports history.
 
• Neeraj Chopra has also won multiple titles at the Asian Games and the Commonwealth Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Javelin Throw**

 
 
• It is a track-and-field event where the athlete throws a spear-like implement called a javelin as far as possible.
 
• The javelin must be held at its grip and thrown overhand.
 
• Competitors typically take a running start before throwing the javelin.
 
• The javelin must land tip first for the throw to be valid.
 
 
 
• **Olympics**
 
 
• The Olympics is a major international multi-sport event held every four years.
 
• It features summer and winter sports competitions, where thousands of athletes from around the world participate.
 
• The modern Olympics were first held in 1896 in Athens, Greece.
 
• The event aims to promote unity and fair competition among nations.
 
 
 
• **Asian Games**
 
 
• The Asian Games, also known as Asiad, is a multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from Asia.
 
• The event is organized by the Olympic Council of Asia (OCA).
 
• The first Asian Games were held in 1951 in New Delhi, India.
 
• It is the second-largest multi-sport event after the Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Commonwealth Games**
 
 
• The Commonwealth Games is an international multi-sport event involving athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• The event is held every four years.
 
• The first Commonwealth Games were held in 1930 in Hamilton, Canada.
 
• The Games aim to foster goodwill and camaraderie among member nations.
